{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The ridge walk eases you into Bali with green views and a breeze that does half the work."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old palace gates and carvings are a quiet, free peek into Ubud’s royal side."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A laid-back local warung with honest Balinese plates and plenty of veggie picks."}]}
